description: Adapter-aware v7 ablations on the 1851-document clean labeled set. The main line matches the locked M05 training interface: Y-network, type-aware propagation, hard MERGE gate, CE + OHEM, and the v7 GNNViewAdapter graph contract.

experiments.name: M05_current_y_network
experiments.hypothesis: The locked main model should retain MERGE precision while preserving strong PARENT_CHILD through type-aware propagation.
experiments.purpose: Y-network + type-aware message mask + hard MERGE gate.

experiments.name: A00_old_shared_gat
experiments.hypothesis: The old shared-head GAT should underperform the Y-network because MERGE and PARENT_CHILD need different information paths.
experiments.purpose: Shared predictor head with ordinary GAT propagation, keeping all other training settings fixed.

experiments.name: A01_no_message_passing
experiments.hypothesis: Removing message passing should help local MERGE cleanliness but hurt hierarchy attachment.
experiments.purpose: No GNN layers; classify edges from projected node and edge features only.

experiments.name: A02_no_type_aware_message_mask
experiments.hypothesis: If float/table/noise propagation pollutes edge decisions, using all edges for message passing should degrade MERGE or stability.
experiments.purpose: Same Y-network, but all candidate edges participate in GAT propagation.

experiments.name: F00_no_scibert
experiments.hypothesis: Without SciBERT, paragraph continuation and semantic attachment should become weaker.

experiments.name: F01_no_geometry_layout
experiments.hypothesis: Without geometry and layout features, the model should lose physical hierarchy and column/float awareness.
experiments.purpose: Keep semantic/type cues, zero bbox, scroll, derived, style, sequence, column, title, layer and flow-context features.

experiments.name: F02_no_v7_reading_flow
experiments.hypothesis: Removing repaired reading-flow cues should expose the value of v7 band/column flow reconstruction.
experiments.purpose: Zero sequence, scroll, column, layout-layer and flow-context cues plus edge index/layout-flow bins.

experiments.name: E00_no_punctuation
experiments.hypothesis: Terminal punctuation and hyphen probes are critical MERGE boundary signals.
experiments.purpose: Remove source punctuation and hyphen edge probes.

experiments.name: E01_no_gutter_overlap
experiments.hypothesis: Gutter and Y-overlap features suppress cross-column false merge.
experiments.purpose: Remove y-overlap and x-gutter edge features.

experiments.name: M07_y_network_gaussian_edge_feature
experiments.hypothesis: A Gaussian proximity cue should improve stability by making physical distance easier for the edge heads and GAT edge MLP to use.
experiments.purpose: Append runtime gaussian_proximity derived from center_distance; graph tensors stay immutable.
